releases.name: v0.4.1: faster Codex replies, kept-warm app-server
releases.body:
﻿Faster Codex replies from WeChat, especially after the PC wakes from sleep.

- **Codex background program kept running**: the process that receives WeChat messages starts its own `codex app-server` right away and keeps it running (no 10-minute idle stop). `/stop` closes it (after a reply started from WeChat finishes), `/start` opens it again; it restarts itself with backoff if it crashes. Sending to a conversation that isn't open in the Codex window no longer waits 3 to 9 s for it to start.
- **No queueing behind slow commands**: messages for different conversations are handled in parallel, in order within one conversation. `帮助`, `列表` and `额度` answer at once.
- **`N` and `N 历史` for Codex** read the local history database (milliseconds) and fall back to the old path when it's incomplete.
- **After sleep**: wake is detected and polling resumes immediately; reconnect waits are capped at 30 s (were up to 5 min).

Codex 从微信发消息更快了，电脑睡醒后尤其明显：
- Codex 后台程序一直开着，不再空闲 10 分钟就关；「/stop」关掉它，「/start」重新打开。
- 慢的命令不再挡着别的：「帮助」「列表」「额度」马上回。
- 「N」「N 历史」直接读本地记录，几毫秒出结果。
- 电脑睡醒后马上重新收消息，断网重连最多等 30 秒（原来最长 5 分钟）。

Install / update: `npx agent-wechat-bridge@latest setup`

releases.name: v0.4.0: smarter quota use, /start and /stop
releases.body:
﻿Use WeChat's send quota carefully, and pause the bridge from WeChat.

**Quota** (WeChat lets a bot send about 10 messages per message you send):
- Bigger messages: up to 3500 characters per message (was 1800); the file offer is folded into the final reply.
- Priority: the last 3 sends are kept for approvals, questions, errors, final replies and command replies. Live progress and file offers go first when quota runs low; live progress slows from every 15 s to every 60 s once half is used.
- Nothing is lost: when the quota runs out, unsent messages wait in a queue (20 items, 24 h). One notice tells you how many are waiting; your next message flushes them in order.
- `额度` / `/quota` shows usage and the queue size.

**Pause / resume**:
- `/stop` (or `停止服务`) pauses the whole bridge: no pushes from any process, WeChat commands ignored except `/start`, `帮助`, `额度`; Codex approvals stay on the computer. The paused state survives restarts.
- `/start` resumes and sends anything queued before the pause.
- **Changed:** plain `/stop` no longer stops a conversation's running reply. Use `N /stop` (e.g. `3 /stop`) for that.

If long messages arrive truncated on your phone, set `WECHAT_NOTIFY_CHUNK=1800`.

额度：单条消息最多 3500 字，文件清单并进最终回复；最后 3 条留给批准、提问、出错、最终回复和命令回复；额度用完后没发出去的消息排队，回任意一句话就补发；发「额度」看用量。暂停：「/stop」暂停整个服务，「/start」恢复。注意：不带编号的「/stop」现在是暂停服务，停某个对话要写「3 /stop」。

Install / update: `npx agent-wechat-bridge@latest setup`

releases.name: v0.3.0: send files to WeChat on request
releases.body:
﻿Send files from your computer to WeChat, on request.

- **File offers after each turn** (OpenCode and Codex): when a turn mentions or changes files, one extra message lists them with sizes. Reply `N 文件 1 3` to receive the ones you pick, `N 文件 全部` for all, or ignore it and nothing is sent. Offers expire after 24 h; `N 文件` shows the current one again.
- **Send any file by path**: `文件 路径` / `/file 路径` (relative paths use the folder picked with `目录`).
- **What gets listed**: paths in the final reply plus files the turn created or edited (OpenCode write/edit tools and session diff; Codex `fileChange` items). Images still arrive automatically and are not listed. Likely secrets (`.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa*`, `auth.json`, `.ssh/`, `~/.cli-bridge`, …) are never offered.
- **Switch**: `文件提示 关` / `文件提示 开` (`/files off|on`).
- Limits: 50 MB per file; each file is one bot message and counts toward WeChat's ~10 messages per message you send.
- CDN uploads retry on 5xx and dropped connections (images benefit too).

微信里也能收文件了：每轮跑完，产出或提到的文件会列成一条清单，回「N 文件 1 3」发你选的，「N 文件 全部」全发，不回复就不发，不会堆在聊天里。也可以用「文件 路径」直接发电脑上的任意文件。图片照旧直接发；像密钥的文件不会出现在清单里。单个文件最大 50 MB。

Install / update: `npx agent-wechat-bridge@latest setup`

releases.name: v0.2.0: works without OpenCode (Codex-only)
releases.body:
﻿Codex-only users can now use everything from WeChat.

- **Standalone daemon** (`agent-wechat-bridge daemon`, `daemon.js`): receives WeChat messages and runs the commands without OpenCode. `setup` installs it at login automatically when OpenCode isn't installed (hidden launcher in the Windows Startup folder, LaunchAgent on macOS, systemd user unit on Linux). With OpenCode installed, add `--daemon` to also receive messages while OpenCode is closed. `--no-daemon` skips it; `setup --uninstall-daemon` removes and stops it.
- **One receiver at a time**: the OpenCode plugin and the daemon share `~/.cli-bridge/poll.lock` (heartbeat every 15 s, a dead holder is replaced within about a minute), so they can run side by side.
- `setup` no longer writes an OpenCode config when OpenCode isn't installed.
- Commands for OpenCode conversations reply "OpenCode isn't running" instead of failing when only the daemon runs.

只用 Codex 的用户现在也能在微信里完整使用：新增后台程序 `daemon.js`，没装 OpenCode 时 `setup` 会把它设成开机自动启动；装了 OpenCode 的可以加 `--daemon`，OpenCode 关着时也能收消息。插件和后台程序靠 `~/.cli-bridge/poll.lock` 保证同一时间只有一个在收消息。

Install / update: `npx agent-wechat-bridge@latest setup`

## English

First public release. Drive OpenCode (V2 server plugin) and Codex (hooks) from WeChat through a ClawBot (iLink bot API). Node standard library only.

**Features**
- Push each turn's final reply, merged live progress and errors to WeChat, with images mentioned in replies.
- Approve permission requests by replying `3 y` / `3 n` (Codex desktop: answer on the PC or in WeChat, whichever comes first).
- Answer the agent's questions from WeChat (option number, option text or free text).
- Continue any OpenCode or Codex conversation with `3 your message`, read history, `/model`, `/stop`, `/compact`, undo, start a new conversation in a chosen folder, send images and files.
- `setup.js` registers the plugin and the three Codex hooks in one step (backs up first, idempotent, keeps JSONC comments; `--dry-run`, `--opencode-only`, `--codex-only`).

**Install from source**
```sh
git clone https://github.com/xixi25937/agent-wechat-bridge
cd agent-wechat-bridge
node setup.js
```
Log in the WeChat bot first with `npx -p cli-chat-bridge wechat-setup`. After `setup`, trust the hooks in `codex` → `/hooks` and restart OpenCode.

**Known limitations**
- One WeChat bot, one account.
- WeChat allows about 10 bot messages after each message you send; send the bot any message to reset it.
- Codex desktop integration uses an undocumented local IPC (`codex-ipc`, checked on desktop 26.1023) and may break on Codex updates.
- The Codex terminal UI (`codex`) cannot answer questions from WeChat; answer in the terminal.
- Developed and used on Windows only; needs OpenCode 2.x and Node.js 20.3+.

## 中文

首个公开版本。通过微信 ClawBot（iLink bot API）在微信里控制 OpenCode（V2 服务端插件）和 Codex（hooks）。只用 Node 标准库，无依赖。

**功能**
- 每轮最终回复、合并后的实时进度和错误推送到微信，回复里提到的图片一并发送。
- 回复 `3 y` / `3 n` 批准权限请求（Codex 桌面端：电脑上或微信里先答的算数）。
- 在微信里回答 Agent 的提问（选项编号、选项文字或自由文本）。
- `3 你的消息` 继续任意 OpenCode / Codex 对话，查看历史，`/model`、`/stop`、`/compact`、撤回、在指定目录新建对话、发送图片和文件。
- `setup.js` 一步配好插件和 Codex 的三个 hook（先备份、可重复运行、保留 JSONC 注释；支持 `--dry-run`、`--opencode-only`、`--codex-only`）。

**从源码安装**
```sh
git clone https://github.com/xixi25937/agent-wechat-bridge
cd agent-wechat-bridge
node setup.js
```
先用 `npx -p cli-chat-bridge wechat-setup` 登录微信机器人。`setup` 之后，在 `codex` 里 `/hooks` 信任 hook，并重启 OpenCode。

**已知限制**
- 只支持一个微信机器人、一个账号。
- 微信限制每发一条消息后机器人最多回约 10 条；给机器人发任意一条消息即可重置。
- Codex 桌面端集成使用未公开的本地 IPC（`codex-ipc`，在桌面版 26.1023 上验证），Codex 更新后可能失效。
- Codex 终端界面（`codex`）不能在微信里回答提问，请在终端里回答。
- 只在 Windows 上开发和使用；需要 OpenCode 2.x 和 Node.js 20.3+。
